item.title: MLK used basketball to start a movement. Here's how he built community on the court
item.description: Can basketball really change a nation? Hear from the filmmakers of "Hoops, Hopes & Dreams," to learn how Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. used sports to foster community and connection.

item.title: FDNY firefighter honored in walkout ceremony after two-week-long hospital stay
item.description: Christopher Dorato of Engine 167 underwent five surgeries after battling a fire on Staten Island.

item.title: 'The Secret Agent' star Wagner Moura making Oscars history: 'Beautiful moment for Brazilian culture'
item.description: Wagner Moura is making Oscars history. "The Secret Agent" star is the first Brazilian nominated for Best Actor. The recognition comes just one year after "I'm Still Here" became Brazil's first film to win Best International Feature at the Academy Awards.

item.title: Trump's Fort Bragg visit spotlights special forces who captured Venezuela's Maduro
item.description: Trump meet with military families and soldiers involved in the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: NYPD searching for suspects after man sitting in BMW shot and killed in Bronx
item.description: Police say the victim was able to talk to them when they arrived at the scene and told them three men in all black opened fire.

item.title: Nurses at Montefiore, Mount Sinai to start returning to work Saturday morning
item.description: Nurses at the two hospital systems voted to ratify new contracts earlier this week.

item.title: What to know about the Homeland Security shutdown starting this weekend
item.description: Another shutdown for parts of the federal government is expected this weekend as lawmakers debate new restrictions on President Donald Trump's immigration enforcement agenda.

item.title: Commack High School student shares surprise phone call about acceptance into West Point
item.description: One phone call changed the life of Commack High School senior Francesco Delio, who learned he was accepted into West Point from Congressman Nick LaLota.

item.title: Salt Lake City high school student raises money to buy flowers for female staff, students
item.description: A Salt Lake City high school student wanted to make sure that none of the female staff or students felt unloved this Valentine's Day, so he started a GoFundMe to raise money for flowers.

item.title: Teenager jumps into action after child falls through ice in Queens
item.description: A FDNY firefighter made a daring ice rescue in Queens - just hours after he trained for the exact thing.
